Hero.subheadline: We help everyone who seriously wants to become strong and fit, and is willing to work hard for it.

Intro.heading: Welcome to CrossFit Leek
paragraphs: Since November 2024, we've been helping residents of Leek, Roden, Zevenhuizen, Marum and all the surrounding villages build a stronger body and a stronger mind. We do this through workouts that can always be scaled to everyone's level.

We understand that taking the first step to start training can be exciting. There are some pretty fit people training here too, but our members are incredibly diverse. Some need to stay fit for their job, others are preparing for a specific fitness race like a HYROX. But most people just want to get a bit fitter. Everyone trains in the same group of around 6-12 people per class, regardless of their level.

You have to start somewhere, and everyone respects that, because every member was once a beginner too. Our coaches are highly experienced and used to adjusting the training for you in every class, so you can do the workout in the way that's best for you.
Intro.closingLine: Come and get to know CrossFit by trying it for free for 2 weeks, and discover whether CrossFit Leek is right for you.

items.title: CrossFit
items.tagline: For those who want to improve everything.
items.description: Strength, conditioning, mobility, technique and skills come together in one complete training session. Every workout is different and scaled to your level.

items.title: Strength
items.description: Want to get stronger and gain more control over weights? Strength sessions focus on building general strength in the key lifts. You'll learn solid technique and get stronger step by step.

items.title: Endurance
items.description: For those who want to take their conditioning and work capacity to the next level. During Endurance you're moving almost nonstop for 35–45 minutes. Ideal preparation for a HYROX event, a survival run, or simply getting fitter.

items.title: SWEAT
items.tagline: Get fitter at your own level.
items.description: Get fitter, feel stronger and enjoy moving — without needing to be fit already. SWEAT is accessible for beginners and anyone picking up exercise again. This class is very suitable for the 60+ age group. You train at your own level in a small, motivating group.

items.title: Kids & Teens
items.description: We also offer training for kids and teens focused on movement, fun and development. They learn to move stronger and better, work together, and build confidence in what they can do.
items.imageAlt: Kids and teens during a training session

items.title: Personal Training
items.description: Want to work towards a specific goal? With Personal Training you get one-on-one coaching fully tailored to your body, experience and goal.
items.imageAlt: Coach and athlete during Personal Training
